name: Abu al-Khayr Marthad ibn Abdullah al-Yazani
nameAr: مرثد بن عبد الله اليزني، أبو الخير المصري
shortAr: أبو الخير مرثد بن عبد الله

orthography.spelled: al-Yazani: fathah on the ya' and the zay, then nun (Taqrib); Marthad with tha' (al-Nawawi).

diedNote: 90 (Sa'id ibn Kathir ibn Ufayr; Ibn Sa'd; Khalifah; Ibn Hibban). Al-Mizzi notes in the margin that al-Kamal's "70" is an error; al-Nawawi's Sharh Muslim repeats the 70.

deathVariants.authority: Sa'id ibn Kathir ibn Ufayr; Ibn Sa'd; Khalifah ibn Khayyat; Ibn Hibban
Abd al-Ghani's al-Kamal (called an error by al-Mizzi); al-Nawawi, Sharh Muslim 2/11
deathVariants.source: Tahdhib al-Kamal 27/358, marginal note; Sharh Muslim 2/11

role: Mufti of Egypt in his time; Abd al-Aziz ibn Marwan would seat him to give fatwa (Ibn Yunus)

teachers.name: Abdullah ibn Amr ibn al-As
teachers.nameAr: عبد الله بن عمرو بن العاص

teachers.name: Uqbah ibn Amir al-Juhani, whom he never left

verdicts.ar: رجل صدق، وقد كان عند أهل مصر مثل علقمة عند أهل الكوفة
verdicts.en: A truthful man; he was to the people of Egypt what Alqamah was to the people of Kufa.
verdicts.source: Tarikh al-Duri 2/555 (editor's note to Tahdhib al-Kamal 27/358); Tahdhib al-Tahdhib 4/45

verdicts.ar: كان ثقة له فضل وعبادة، مات سنة تسعين في خلافة الوليد بن عبد الملك
verdicts.en: He was reliable, with merit and devotion; he died in 90 in the caliphate of al-Walid ibn Abd al-Malik.
verdicts.source: al-Tabaqat 7/511 (editor's note to Tahdhib al-Kamal 27/358); Ikmal Tahdhib al-Kamal 11/119

verdicts.ar: كان مفتي أهل مصر في زمانه، وكان عبد العزيز بن مروان يحضره فيجلسه للفتيا
verdicts.en: He was the mufti of Egypt in his time; Abd al-Aziz ibn Marwan would summon him and seat him to give legal opinions.

dhahabi.en: He was the mufti of Egypt.

flags.label: Homonym
flags.detail: Not Marthad ibn Abdullah al-Zimmani (or al-Dhimari), Abu Malik, father of Malik ibn Marthad, graded maqbul in the Taqrib and placed by al-Uqayli among those whose hadith is not corroborated (Shamela record 6045). Both are third-generation men named Marthad ibn Abdullah.

flags.label: Death date
flags.detail: 90 by the consensus of Ibn Sa'd, Khalifah and Ibn Hibban; the "70" in al-Kamal and in al-Nawawi's Sharh Muslim is an error noted by al-Mizzi himself.

bio: The Egyptian Successor whom Ibn Ma'in compared to Alqamah in Kufa: the man a whole school looked to. He accompanied the Companion Uqbah ibn Amir constantly, heard Abdullah ibn Amr ibn al-As, Zayd ibn Thabit and Abu Ayyub, and was the mufti of Egypt under Abd al-Aziz ibn Marwan, who seated him for fatwa. Yazid ibn Abi Habib, who succeeded him as mufti, carried his hadith to al-Layth. Known by his kunya Abu al-Khayr in the chains; all six compilers use him.
